trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap stages in order and this one follows last.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1).
Clear the stranger strands, activities and collectibles (Stages 2–4).
Finish the crime and money trophies and the 100% checklist (Stage 5).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Just play the opening; nothing can be missed here.
steps: Play through the opening.
Complete the mission Gone Fishing.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 1 and it pops. Before the chapter ends, meditate at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude): that spot is only open in Chapter 1.
steps: Play through Chapter 1.
Meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
Complete the final mission of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 2 and it pops on its own. Nothing to prepare and nothing missable.
steps: Play through Chapter 2.
Complete its final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 3 and it pops on its own. Keep playing the story; the trophy follows the chapters.
steps: Play through Chapter 3.
Complete its final mission.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 4 and it pops on its own. By now the map is mostly open, so side activities started in earlier chapters can be picked up again later.
steps: Play through Chapter 4.
Complete its final mission.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish the final mission and the gold pops as the credits roll. Free roam stays open afterwards, so finishing the story locks nothing out; the cleanup stages start here.
steps: Finish Chapters 1–4.
Complete the final mission.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats to see the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up naturally in the story; no special approach is needed.
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this one arrives on its own as you play.
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Child's Play. Another story beat; play the mission through and the trophy follows.
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play.
Complete it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Headliners. It unlocks as part of the story with no extra requirement.
steps: Reach the mission Headliners.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting ties into the VCIA area other trophies mention, but the mission itself is pure story.
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown.
Complete it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies; finish it and Stage 1 is nearly done.
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Complete it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The grind trophy: reach 100% completion. After the finale, the checklist sits under Touch Pad > Progress > Stats. KeenGamer reports its contents as 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 100 optional tasks, 15 full card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 42 Shooting Range gold medals and 42 Drone Time Trials. Most of it overlaps the other trophies, so chase it stage by stage instead of saving it all for the end.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the robbery counts (gang ops, bank jobs, vaults).
Clear the collectibles (cards, WAiNK, flamingos, underwater).
Finish the 42 Shooting Range golds and 42 Drone Time Trials.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt spots are marked on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots, and progress is tracked at Progress > Activities > Stunts (Push Square). Jumps, near-misses and drifts all count, so fold stunts into everyday driving instead of hunting all 250 in one sitting.
steps: Open the map: Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Attempt the marked stunts — jumps and airtime count.
Track the total at Progress > Activities > Stunts until 250.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PSN counts 9 types; the counter ticks the first time you try a new one, so sample everything early — a race, the shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, a stunt, a challenge and a meditation — and the trophy follows.
steps: Try a race.
Try the Shooting Range, fishing, an arcade game and bowling.
Try a Top Fun drone race, a stunt, a challenge and a meditation spot.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges sit around Leonida and each challenge shows its gold score in-game. Work through one weapon class at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn the thresholds.
steps: Find a Shooting Range.
Clear each challenge, aiming for the gold score shown in-game.
Repeat across all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — KeenGamer counts 14 of them. These are head-to-head race wins, not the 42 Drone Time Trials (those feed the 100% checklist instead). Learn each course's line before racing it for the win.
steps: Find a Top Fun location.
Win its drone race.
Repeat at all 14 locations.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Mix street, off-road and water races; the counter only moves on a first win at each event, so keep moving to new start lines.
steps: Enter a race you have not won yet.
Win it.
Repeat at 19 more different events.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. KeenGamer reports this as a fishing rival event; this guide has not confirmed the exact trigger in-game yet, so check the source before booking a long fishing session.
steps: Find the fishing challenge against Cal.
Beat his catch.
If the challenge does not appear, check KeenGamer for the latest trigger.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any cabinet game through to its end. Arcades are scattered around Vice City; pick the shortest game on your first visit and the trophy is a quick one.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play a game through to its end.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Andy's final mission. Stranger icons appear on the map as you explore — start Andy's chain when you pass it and follow it to its end.
steps: Find Andy's stranger icon.
Play his missions through.
Complete his final mission.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Kenton's final mission. Like the other stranger chains, it is a short series of missions ending in one finale — follow the map icon.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger icon.
Play his missions through.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Billy's final mission. Start the chain at his map icon and play it through to the finale.
steps: Find Billy's stranger icon.
Play his missions through.
Complete his final mission.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. PowerPyx reports the count as 8; the strands this guide can name are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus three more stranger chains. Start each one when its icon appears and finish the strand — a strand only counts once its final mission is done.
steps: Start every stranger icon you pass.
Finish each strand's final mission.
Repeat until 8 strands are complete.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Randy's final mission. Follow his chain from the map icon to its finale.
steps: Find Randy's stranger icon.
Play his missions through.
Complete his final mission.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps: Find Tyrone's stranger icon.
Play his missions through.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. THE missable warning: PowerPyx reports the first spot — at Jason's house — can only be used in Chapter 1, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. Every later spot stays open, and the trophy pops once the last spot is done.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house — do not leave this for later.
Find and meditate at each remaining spot across Leonida.
The trophy pops at the last spot.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. KeenGamer reports this as a hunting request from Bret; the animal and the spot are not yet confirmed in-game, so treat this as a lead and check the source for the latest details before a long hunt.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting request.
Track the unique animal he names.
Bring it down and return to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; 18 sets exist in total and 15 full sets feed the 100% checklist (Push Square), but this trophy only needs 3 complete sets — finish the three sets you find most of first.
steps: Collect cards as you explore.
Complete any 3 full sets.
The trophy pops at the third completed set.

steps: Open WAiNK It at a new location.
Repeat at 99 more distinct locations.
Sweep district by district so none are missed.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small open-world tasks tracked under Progress; they overlap stunts, races and collectibles, so most of the 50 arrive while you chase the other trophies — check Progress to see which kinds are still short.
steps: Open Progress to see your challenge counts.
Clear the easiest challenge types first.
Keep going until 50 are done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape. Build 4 stars together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear — both of you must get away clean.
steps: With your partner, raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Stay hidden until the stars clear.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in one run while keeping the heat on; if the wanted level drops between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: With your partner, rob a first shop.
Move straight to a second shop and rob it.
Rob a third without the wanted level clearing.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts once, so vary what you drive instead of sticking to one car — boats, bikes, trucks and planes all add to the count.
steps: Drive a vehicle you have never used.
Repeat with new vehicles.
The counter climbs to 100 on its own if you keep switching.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies with a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — a gang hideout or a heavy police shootout gives the best odds of five targets at once.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

Make your unscheduled departure as the source describes.
Escape the airport area to bank it.

Take the goods without tripping an alarm.
Leave undetected.

Crack the vault and escape cleanly.
Repeat until 5 vaults are done.

Rob it.
Escape the wanted level.

Cover the Keys, the swamps and the city.
Keep going until the map is fully revealed.

Buy vehicles and property extras.
